scope: Isolated test of slider-width=15 and trough-border=0 as a possible way to expand the GTK2 stepper paint clip

candidate.source_palette: Copied from active DomainOS KDE-role GTK2 palette; only geometry values changed in the test copy.

results.overlay_clip: A 15x15 opaque sentinel painted all 225 pixels of each stepper cell.
results.bar_thickness: The forced 543x15 fixture remained 15px high; the candidate does not keep the VUE end-cell placement or the 2px trough border.

decision: Reject this property pair as a production correction. It expands the drawing area but moves both stepper cells outward by 2px and removes the 2px trough inset measured in SR10.4.
next: Preserve the GTK2 geometry. Investigate whether a GTK2 rc draw path can complete only the four outer relief pixels using dynamic KDE light/shadow roles; document the pixbuf-engine clip limitation if no rc path supports this. Do not accept a fix that moves the stepper cells.
